user.title: NHS Give Blood
user.description: Sign in with the same email address and password you use for the NHS Give Blood app. Your password is stored in Home Assistant so the integration can recover on its own when NHS Blood and Transplant rotates its access tokens.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: NHS Give Blood rejected the stored credentials. Sign in again to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach NHS Give Blood. This is usually temporary — check https://my.blood.co.uk and try again.
error.invalid_auth: That email address and password were rejected. Check them in the NHS Give Blood app first.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This donor account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different donor account. Sign in with the account this entry was originally set up with, or add the other account separately.

init.title: NHS Give Blood options
init.description: Donor data changes on the order of days, so there is little to gain from polling frequently.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to check for changes. The default of 30 minutes keeps a booking made in the app appearing promptly without putting needless load on a public health service.
data_description.include_donation_history: Powers the last donation and donations recorded sensors. Turn off to make each update one request lighter.
